changes_vs_current: Spaghetti stays 1; Fettuccine 4 to 2, Lasagna 15 to 3, Macaroni 11 to 4, Penne 2 to 5 (artifact), Angel Hair 17 to 6, Ravioli 13 to 7, Ziti 19 to 8, Tortellini 12 to 9, Farfalle 9 to 10, Manicotti added at 11, Ditalini dropped; 12-24 no poll evidence (Rigatoni, Linguine, Rotini first because Inspired Taste state-level results show each winning states).
confidence: low. Only 3 sources: two are top-5 lists and the third is dish-level. Penne is #2 in Inspired Taste and #3 in Barilla but is absent from the YouGov dish list (no plain-penne dish), so its mechanical rank of 5 is an artifact; it belongs top 3 on shape-level evidence. Lasagna/Macaroni/Ravioli are boosted by YouGov dish popularity (mac and cheese, lasagna), not shape preference. Not found: shape-level US sales (Circana/IRI/NPA) or a Harris/YouGov shape poll. Old Experian 2004 data (spaghetti used by 63.6% of households, macaroni 41%) found but excluded as pre-2019.
